content.short: ADA MINIONS is a CNFT project, that has a goal to create a DAO and to give opportunities to those who haven't got the right resources.
content.description:
I'm multimedia designer turned developer who wants to get back in the artistic space. Since 2000 always hands on with different multimedia platforms like photoshop, macromedia, director, flash, ... Even with that knowledge I never had the chance to grow as an artist . The intention with this project is to create an agency/DAO that will onboard people who are in the same spot I was back then. individuals who didn't had the chance to shine due to the lack of resources (mainly hardware/ software). Backstory The year is 2055, the ADA MINIONS were sent into space by the Cardano Foundation to save the moon… A big part of humanity has been shooting for the moon and buying Lambos. Space travel has become mainstream. The richest men on earth have launched thousands of rockets around the earth and landed on the moon. Space junk has become a nuisance and a lot of space debris is covering the orbit around and on the moon. This is preventing the sun to reflect off the moon and shine on the earth. It’s been a few years that humanity has seen the moon. The ADA MINIONS have successfully removed the debris and were on their way back to earth until their ship got hit by an asteroid and this caused the ADA MINIONS to malfunction and reboot, but their memory got damaged. They are scattered all over the surface of the earth, lost and disoriented …There is one node that needs to sync to all of them (aka the alpha block) I'm aiming to make each collection more dynamic than the previous one. Season 1: 2D flat images Season 2: 2D with motion Season 3: 3D models Season 4: 3D with animation
